name: BBa_26LTB0W1
title: LEA14
description: This part encodes a Late Embryogenesis Abundant 14 protein (LEA14) from *Arabidopsis thaliana* gene *At1g01470.1*, which belongs to LEA\_2 subgroup. The paper showed overexpression of AtLEA14 enhances salt stress tolerance in *Arabidopsis thaliana*. Therefore, LEA14 is might be the potential gene involved in plant responses to abiotic stress. The LEA14 coding sequence was codon-optimized for *B. subtilis*.

name: BBa_26ERHWWI
title: Bopep4 2.2
description: This part encodes BoPep4, a 23-residue plant elicitor peptide (PEP) from broccoli (*Brassica oleracea var. italica);* the wild-type BoPep4 sequence is registered as [BBa\_26ILD3SO](https://registry.igem.org/parts/bba-26ild3so)*.* BoPep4 acts as a peptide hormone and signaling molecule to regulate plant defense mechanisms and salt tolerance. In this variant, the first 15 codons of the coding sequence were optimized to improve the mRNA secondary structure of the translation start site.

name: BBa_26XZYM10
title: PtagC+RBS-Ho1:pcyA-L3S2P21
description: The PCB Production Module supplies the chromophore required for light sensing. It consists of the H*o1-pcyA* CDS, along with the PtagC+RBS composite promoter and RBS and the L3S2P21 terminator, which converts endogenous heme into phycocyanobilin (PCB), the chromophore necessary for CcaS photoreceptor activity. PCB enables the light-sensing system to detect and respond to green light.

name: BBa_26VTO4DX
title: CDS replacable cassette-mScarlet-I
description: This Level 1 module is the customizable output of the optogenetic circuit. It places a replaceable CDS cassette under the control of the green-light-responsive promoter PcpcG2-veg, followed by the EEBD and RBS0 elements and the B0015 terminator. Phosphorylated CcaR activates PcpcG2-veg, so the cassette is expressed in green light and shut off in red light.

name: BBa_261XH2RS
title: PliaG-RBS0-ccaS-m3-B0015
description: This module consists of the engineered sensor kinase CcaS-m3 driven by the constitutive promoter PliaG, the RBS RBS0 and terminator B0015. When supplied with the chromophore phycocyanobilin (PCB) from the PCB Production Module [BBa\_26XZYM10](https://registry.igem.org/parts/bba-26xzym10), ccaS-m3 can detect green light and initiate signal transduction. Altogether, these components enable the conversion of external light stimuli into a regulatory signal for downstream gene expression.
